title: Limit Theory for $N$-Player $α$-Potential Games
summary: The recently introduced framework of $α$-potential games facilitates the analysis of finite-player dynamic games by reducing the search for approximate Nash equilibria to the minimization of a single $α$-potential function. In this work, we show that the approximate potential structure of finite-player games persists in the large-population limit, leading naturally to a notion of $α$-potential mean field games (MFGs). Specifically, we show that both the optimal values and the minimizers of normalized $N$-player $α_N$-potential functions converge to those of a mean field control (MFC) problem…
